args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate after the latest deploy. SRE rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Service health should be verified post-rollback; root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back**: All production regions were rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release with a healthy production track record (v2.3.1-rc was only healthy in staging, so it didn't qualify). Rollout is complete and verified.
3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0") documenting the diagnosis and rollback action. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Remaining follow-up for the on-call team: verify service health post-rollback and investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure.
